deadline.value: The physics flyer gives a priority deadline of December 15, 2026 and a general deadline of January 15, 2027; confirm the Fall 2027 cycle before applying.
deadline.quote: The priority application deadline is December 15, 2026. The general application deadline is January 15, 2027.

gre_general.value: The general GRE is not required and not expected for physics applicants.
gre_general.quote: The general test and physics subject test of the GRE are not required and not expected.

gre_subject.value: The physics GRE Subject test is not required and not expected.
gre_subject.quote: The general test and physics subject test of the GRE are not required and not expected.

supervisor.value: No fetched page says whether a faculty agreement is needed before admission.

funding.value: All doctoral students in good standing are guaranteed five years of full financial support, including payment of fees and tuition.
funding.quote: All doctoral students in good standing are guaranteed five years of full financial support, including payment of fees and tuition.

entry_route.value: The flyer asks only for a baccalaureate degree in a major appropriate to the program; no master's is named.
entry_route.quote: Hold a baccalaureate degree or its equivalent from an accredited institution with a major appropriate to the proposed graduate program.

notes: Physics flyer and research page are on uc-merced.foleon.com. The physics-specific application page (physics.ucmerced.edu) returned 403. A search snippet of the Graduate Division application-dates page says Physics is not accepting Fall 2027 applications; that page could not be fetched, so it is not stated as fact here.
